preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of edges of weight 1 m is between 0 and the maximum possible number of edges, which is either n(n-1)/2 or 10^5, inclusive.
Each edge endpoint a_i and b_i is between 1 and n, inclusive.
Each edge endpoint a_i and b_i are distinct.

preconditions.expression: No edge appears twice in the input
preconditions.description: Each edge appears exactly once in the input.

postconditions.description: The output is the sum of the weights of the edges of weight 1 in the minimum spanning tree.
